boundedPriceSuitability.evidence: https://docs.chain.link/data-feeds/selecting-data-feeds#bounded-market-price-feeds: this exact USDT/USD source has stablecoinCapped=true and maxSubmissionValue=105000000 (1.05 USD at 8 decimals). Accept this residual risk only for this chain's exact fixed buy token; no assumed dollar peg or bounded sell approval. Bridge risk, where present, is accepted separately and is not measured by this feed.
